{{Quote|Oh! It's a nexu &ndash; and she has cubs! How cute!''"<br />"''For creatures with four eyes and a mouthful of teeth, they are rather cute.|[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Fate" />}}
'''Nexu''' were [[Feline/Legends|feline]] creatures native to the chilly forests of the [[Indona]] continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]].<ref name="Nexu-DB">{{DB|creature|nexu|nexu}}</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Nexu-SWM80.png|thumb|left|200px|A nexu]]
There were other breeds of nexu on Cholganna's other continents, but only the forest nexu had an additional set of eyes able to view in [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] wavelength, which aided in their hunting of [[Bark rat/Legends|bark rats]] and tree-climbing [[Arboreal octopus/Legends|octopi]]. They were often exported and trained as security beasts, as used for patrolling on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], or used in arena combat, as seen on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Nexu were 4.5 meters long<ref name="H2H" /> and generally 1 meter tall.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

The nexu appeared to be feline in nature, with claws which could slice a [[Human/Legends|Human]] in half. They had quills along their back, and a long tail that in the wild allowed the nexu to swing from tree branch to tree branch. The tail also split into two equal sections for a better grip on the tree branch they were swinging from. They had extremely sharp instincts and reflexes, although they were known to tire easily, and often used swift movements to finish an enemy quickly, biting down and thrashing their head about to break their victim's neck. Their [[Nexu tongue|tongue]] could be served as a delicacy.<ref name="Tongue">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Prep Work: Nexu Tongue|Corellia}}</ref> Cubs were born pure [[Color/Legends|white]]. A particularly stealthy variety was the [[black nexu]]; this species was also one of the rarest.

While they were native to the planet Cholganna, they eventually became alpha predators throughout the galaxy'','' adapting to new environments through a natural hardiness and a quick reproductive cycle. Packs of nexu could be found roaming the tundra of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and the jungles of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Nexu Swtor">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nexu}}</ref>

Nexu were recognised in many cultures as an icon of viciousness, and several [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans took the creature as their symbol. Some xenobiologists argued that nexu were far less violent than commonly believed and that it was the activities of sentient beings that agitated them. Left alone, they were smart, capable and strong but not cruel or aggressive.<ref name="Nexu Swtor" />

==History==
[[File:Bestial_Fury_SM.png|thumb|left|200px|A nexu leaps from the trees on Cholganna]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an escaped [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] population of Nexu thrived on the destroyed [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="swtor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Difficult to train as [[watch-beast]]s, they were instead sought after for arena battles where their ferocity was much appreciated by spectators ( It was the most favored monster). This resulted in many big-game hunters making regular visits to Cholganna, hoping to capture a live nexu for export. Many hunters ended up dead however, when tracking prides of nexu, and as a result fees for live nexus often ranged up to half a million credits per animal. Buyers such as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] willingly paid such prices however, in order to add these magnificent creatures to their collections.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Bounty Hunter note">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' is set immediately after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] faced many nexu on his visit to Malastare, during his [[The Hunt|hunt]] for [[Komari Vosa]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

[[File:Nexu.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Unidentified nexu/Legends|nexu]] attacking [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]]]
A [[Unidentified nexu/Legends|nexu]] was used during the attempted execution of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and its actions could be considered typical of the species. It would climb towards its victim, strike, then return to the ground quickly, waiting to see if its enemy would strike back. It was an extremely aggressive creature, snapping, clawing and roaring in the general direction of Amidala. When a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] guard attempted to direct it with a blast from his [[Static pike/Legends|static pike]], this only served to irritate the creature further and the guard was quickly devoured. An agile hunter that sacrificed bone mass for speed, a kick from Amidala knocked it down, weakening its tender body greatly. A [[Unidentified reek/Legends|reek]], steered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], finally rammed the stunned nexu, killing it instantly.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>

After asking for a pet for years, Skywalker and Amidala's great-granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] was given a nexu cub in [[43 ABY]]. This was after [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] killed the baby nexu's mother to save an Ithorian, who was under attack from the creature at the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]]. She named the baby cub [[Anji]].

By [[130 ABY]], wild nexu were a common and dangerous sight on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and tourists were advised to stay with their groups when sightseeing on the capital. The nexu were usually seen in areas of the planet still scarred by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] war, a hundred years prior.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nexu_Concept_Art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by [[Robert E. Barnes]]]]
The nexu seen in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] was nicknamed as "[[Bad Kitty/Legends|Bad Kitty]]" by the [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] animation team during production of the film.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

Art Department concept sculptor Robert Barnes developed the look of the nexu, after several early sketches depicted rather literal interpretations of a [[Wikipedia:lion|lion]]-like creature. By intermixing different species traits, like [[Wikipedia:Reptile|reptilian]] and even human characteristics, Barnes developed an unsettlingly vicious design.<ref name="Nexu-DB" />

In the non-[[canon]] comic book ''[[Star Wars Infinities: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] has a pair of nexu that are later released by the protagonists, instead of his infamous [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. These nexu ravage Jabba's throne room, and it is later remarked that a better choice for a pet would be something more stable&mdash;like a rancor, hinting that Jabba might have had nexu<ref name="Episode V Infinities">''[[Star Wars Infinities: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> prior to [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> However, this story is an "alternate reality" and not considered canon.
